title: feat(website): new shell, home and legal pages from website v2
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Part of #14472. Second slice after #15973; each slice makes main's files match `feat/website-v2`.

- Adds v2's header, footer, scenes, styles and Worker, plus Home, Privacy, Terms and Refunds, copied verbatim.
- Keeps the old Apps, Community and Play pages inside the new frame until their own slices land. They look mixed (cream cards on the new background) in the meantime.
- Loads the old `tailwind.config.ts` beside the shared theme for those pages only. Names both define (`font-body`, `rounded-card`, `font-pixel`) resolve to the new theme. The config goes with the last old page.
- Adds a `© Myceli.AI OÜ` line to the footer, which v2 gets too.
- Removes the past `night.html` event page and the old scene images. The Worker redirects `www.` to the apex.
- Adds a `website` CI job (build + tests), and the deploy workflow now uses `npm ci`. The site still deploys only from `production`.

Verified locally: tsc, 66 tests, build, desktop and 390px light/dark, no sideways scroll, and Play login round-trip to enter.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: A new home for the hive
gist.blurb: The website gets a new front door: a redesigned home page, day-and-night scenery, and a shared frame for the pages already inside.
gist.summary: Website v2 brings a new header, footer, Home and legal pages, and day/night scenes, while keeping Apps, Community, and Play accessible within the new shell.
gist.impact: Visitors get a refreshed home page with sections for apps, building, and Quests; the existing Apps, Community, and Play pages keep working as their own redesigns follow.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the website redesign as a cozy browser-shaped garden shed with a new header and footer framing a home-page garden. Small signposts for Apps, Community, and Play remain inside; paired sun and moon windows suggest the day/night artwork. Polli tends a lime-green code-plant beside a Quests card.
